messages:
maria: quick sync — where are we on the tracing hook rollout and the new low-cardinality error view? need a canary in us-west by EOD wed. also: what's the expected ingestion/cost delta?
aj: trace-hook PR merged to main at 09:12, ready for infra canary. default sample_rate changed to 0.1 (was 0.01) in the PR. i ran a backfill sim and saw about +6-8% ingest.
kevin: noted on cost. i'll update the cost model spreadsheet later today (sheet: infra/costs/console-obsv). initial projection +7% with current query mix.
sophia: low-card view is done in the UI branch, waiting on a stable index in staging. queries are optimized to use the new aggregated table — should reduce query cost but not ingestion.
maria: copy. aj — can you paste the command you'll use to kick the canary so eng-sre can prep quotas?
aj: sure:
```
# start canary for trace hooks in us-west
./infra/deploy --service=console-obsv --env=us-west --tag=tracehook-v2 --canary=10%
```
eng-sre: can pre-warm nodepool and bump EBS throughput. expecting the 10% canary to add ~100-150rps of trace events.
deploy-bot: Canary started for service=console-obsv, env=us-west, tag=tracehook-v2, percentage=10% (initiated by aj) :rocket:
aj: thanks. i'll watch the canary windows and post perf + error deltas in this thread.
kevin: on retention: i propose traces=90d, error-aggregates=365d, raw spans=30d. this keeps cost bounded but satisfies most debug needs. open to tradeoffs.
sophia: for PII/compliance some customers need 365 for certain flows. we should add an allowlist in the retention doc so enterprise can opt-in.
maria: sounds good. action items: 1) aj watch canary + post metrics (latency, ingest rate, error rate) by +30/60 mins; 2) kevin update retention doc and add opt-in allowlist; 3) sophia validate dashboard queries against aggregated table; 4) eng-sre confirm quota bump is done. i'll collate into the roadmap tracker after canary. :white_check_mark:
aj: starting canary now, will post first snapshot at +30m. ping me if anything spikes.
eng-sre: quota bump scheduled and executed at 09:20 UTC, nodes pre-warmed. will escalate if we hit >15% error delta.
maria: thanks everyone. if canary looks stable we'll schedule a gradual rollout to 50% tomorrow.
sophia: small note — UI toggle for low-card view will be behind feature flag `low_card_errors_v1`. planning a canary flip once backend is 50%.
kevin: i linked the retention change PR here: https://git.internal/infra/retention/pulls/42 — feedback welcome.
maria: perfect. closing this sync; ping here for updates and i'll move items into the milestone board. :v:
